business_problem: Using Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service and Azure AI Search, Properstar analyzes unstructured real estate data, provides advanced filtering capabilities, and delivers relevant search results.
solution_summary: Properstar modernized its analytics estate on Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, GitHub Copilot, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. Power BI then serves dashboards, self-service exploration, and decision support to business users at scale. It also connects with surrounding systems such as GitHub Copilot, Property listings and agency feeds, CRM and ERP systems, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. "The extensive Azure ecosystem allowed us to access cutting-edge AI tools and slot them easily into our solution.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Search
solution_components.role: Indexes enterprise content and retrieves grounding context for assistants and search experiences.

solution_components.name: GitHub Copilot
solution_components.role: Accelerates software development by assisting engineers with code generation and editing.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in Azure AI Search, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure storage services, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
